fixtures._comment: Weather is exercised by BOTH the Single-Agent test and the AgentController test, which run in parallel against this one AIMock. sequenceIndex is a SHARED per-process counter, so the two suites race on it. The two-step fixtures match on hasToolResult, which looks only at the CURRENT turn (messages after the last user message): false = the tool call, true = the grounded answer. Not turnIndex: it counts every assistant message in the request, and Memory's resource-scoped semantic recall injects replies from OTHER threads, so a fresh question could land on the answer fixture and skip the tool.
